gdp_yoy.source: MoSPI Provisional Estimates of Annual GDP (FY2025-26) and Quarterly Estimates for Q4 (Jan-Mar) FY2025-26, base year 2022-23 series, released June 5, 2026. Q4 real GDP grew 7.8% YoY — flat vs Q3 FY26 (also 7.8%), not an acceleration. Full-year FY26 provisional growth: 7.7%.

cpi.source: MoSPI Consumer Price Index Press Release for June 2026 (provisional, base year 2024=100); embargoed until 4 PM on July 13, 2026. Confirms a genuine uptrend: 3.48% (Apr) → 3.93% (May) → 4.38% (Jun), driven by rising food (CFPI) inflation.

gsec10y.source: Trading Economics / Whalesbook aggregated India 10Y G-Sec benchmark yield quotes; yield fell from 7.12% (early June 2026) to a 6.73%-6.79% range through mid-July 2026 on foreign inflows and stable crude prices, trading around 6.75%-6.76% as of July 17, 2026.

rate_cut_cycle.note: RBI MPC held repo rate at 5.25% at its June 2026 meeting (third consecutive hold; unanimous decision; neutral stance). No MPC meeting has occurred since — next meeting scheduled Aug 3-5, 2026, so this remains the latest resolution.
rate_cut_cycle.source: RBI Monetary Policy Committee Resolution, June 5, 2026 — repo rate held at 5.25%, neutral stance.

gov_capex.note: CPSEs (63 firms tracked by DPE) hit 25% of their FY27 cumulative capex target in Q1 (Apr-Jun 2026), up from 22% in the same period last year — capex rose 26% YoY to ₹2.10 lakh crore, led by Railways (33% of its FY27 target) and NHAI (24%). Confirms the FY27 capex push remains active and ahead of last year's pace.
gov_capex.source: Business Standard, citing Department of Public Enterprises (DPE) data — 'CPSEs meet 25% of FY27 cumulative capital expenditure target in Q1' (early July 2026).

china_plus_one.note: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal (Jun 12, 2026) said India no longer needs to lean on the 'China+1' label to attract global manufacturers, citing infrastructure buildout, low data costs, and a skilled workforce as standalone draws. India-UK CETA entered into force July 15, 2026, adding further tailwind to manufacturing/export diversification momentum.
china_plus_one.source: BusinessToday coverage of Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal remarks on 'China Plus One' (June 12, 2026); India-UK CETA effective date coverage (July 15, 2026).

rural_recovery.note: Monsoon rainfall deficit ~20% cumulative as of early July 2026 (June 2026 was the 5th driest since 1901); 397 of 741 districts recorded below-normal rainfall as of July 13 (326 deficient, 71 large deficiency), with East/Northeast India hit hardest (-41% vs LPA). Kharif sowing at 53.12 mn hectares as of July 10 vs 63.27 mn ha in the same period last year (10.14 mn ha shortfall); paddy sowing also lagging.
rural_recovery.source: Down To Earth / ANI reporting on IMD rainfall data and Agriculture Ministry kharif sowing progress, as of July 13, 2026.

put_call_ratio.source: NSE Nifty 50 option chain aggregate OI-based put-call ratio via NiftyTrader.in, as of July 16, 2026.
